description: Meson spectral analysis using exact Hoefsmit V_{(2,1)} matrices. Key exact results: chi_std(L+) = chi_std(L-) = -1 EXACTLY, chi_std(e-) = 0 EXACTLY. Meson phase theta_pi = 2.12 rad (NOT near-identity like B_3). Spectral ratio theta_K/theta_pi = 1.015 misses m_K/m_pi = 3.54 by 71%. Meson masses need a different mechanism.

data.conclusion: Meson mass ratio NOT from spectral phase ratio. Different mechanism needed.
